column5: But then, the temperature starts dropping.
Within the first day, the world begins getting colder.
Without sunlight, they would begin to die within weeks.
But this is only the beginning.
And people are beginning to panic.
Because everyone now understands the same thing.
After one week, the average temperature on Earth would be around minus seventeen degrees.
Huge parts of the planet are frozen.
People compete for heat and shelter.
And the surface of Earth is becoming more hostile every day.
But then comes the truly terrifying part.
